purpose: We develop aerosol-delivered compounds for crowd control and need to identify the populations in which an inhaled irritant has the strongest effect, to tune the formulation and the areas where it is most potent.
question: In which regions and age groups are asthma and COPD most common?
definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45; COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Report per region: adults with asthma or COPD.
